name: Fridge repair
summary: How expats get fridge repair in Singapore — warranty vs third-party techs, humid-climate failures, and when replacement beats another gas top-up.
body:
Fridge failures in humid weather often show up as warm compartments, iced evaporators, or noisy compressors. In-warranty jobs go through brand centres; out-of-warranty third-party techs can be faster if parts are stocked.

## Typical jobs
- Not cooling / intermittent cooling
- Water leakage and blocked drains
- Iced freezer walls and fan faults
- Door seal replacement
- Thermostat and PCB faults

Photograph the model sticker before calling.

## How to choose
Ask whether the diagnostic fee offsets repair cost. Prefer techs who explain repair-vs-replace thresholds for ageing compressors. Confirm same-day food-rescue advice while waiting.

## Practical tip
Clear the coil dust and check the door seal before booking. Many “broken” fridges are airflow and seal problems you can spot in five minutes.
